# Versions of: A web of trust for careers

1 published version of [A web of trust for careers: everyone with their own keys and their own repository, links that count only when both sides sign them, companies and universities countersigning who worked and studied where, link lists instead of revocation lists, an agent that checks any of it by following the graph, a business that somebody should build, and names for it, with Europe in mind](../a-web-of-trust-for-careers.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
